prompt: For the STEM OPT online application: Do I also need to upload a copy of my post-completion I-20 in addition to the STEM I-20?
response: Yes, you do need to upload a copy of your post-completion I-20 in addition to your STEM I-20 when applying for STEM OPT online. The STEM OPT program requires that you provide a copy of your post-completion I-20, which is a document that shows your educational background and the duration of your post-secondary education. This document is essential for the program to verify your eligibility and ensure that you are eligible to receive STEM OPT funding. The STEM OPT program uses this information to determine your eligibility for STEM OPT funding and to provide you with the necessary support and resources to pursue your STEM education.
